forms.negative: {切|き}り{取|と}りませんでした

definitions.gloss: to cut off; to cut out
definitions.explanation: To remove a portion by cutting, such as from paper, fabric, or plants.
To select and extract a portion, especially in photography or video editing.

examples.japanese: ⟦クーポン→クーポン：06446_kuupon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{切|き}り{取|と}る。
⟦{枯|か}れた→枯れる：04589_kareru⟧⟦{枝|えだ}→枝：02181_eda⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{切|き}り⟦{取|と}って→取る：00565_toru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please cut off the dead branches.

examples.english: Please carefully cut along the perforated line with scissors.

examples.english: With this photo app, you can neatly crop out just the person.

notes:
{切|き}り{取|と}る is a transitive verb (⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧) formed from ⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧ (to cut) + ⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧ (to take). It emphasizes removing a portion by cutting.

ASPECT (ている):
{切|き}り⟦{取|と}って→取る：00565_toru⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ indicates the cutting action is in progress. {切|き}り⟦{取|と}って→取る：00565_toru⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ means something has been cut out and the result remains.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- [portion]⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{切|き}り{取|と}る — to cut off/out [portion]
- [source]⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧[portion]⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{切|き}り{取|と}る — to cut [portion] from [source]
- ⟦クーポン→クーポン：06446_kuupon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{切|き}り{取|と}る (cut out a coupon)
- ⟦{画像|がぞう}→画像：13549_gazou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{切|き}り{取|と}る (crop an image)
- ⟦{切|き}り{取|と}り→切り取り：08810_kiritori⟧⟦{線|せん}→線：09901_sen⟧ (perforated line, "cut here" line)

MODERN USAGE:
In digital contexts, {切|き}り{取|と}る is the standard term for cropping images or trimming video.
